items.label: lapsed members won back last year
items.note: I know what each of them last ordered

components.text: Nine years taught me why members stop coming. Now I want to **build that into the product**.

notes: Why me? A membership product manager has to answer two questions: why do members stop coming, and what brings them back. I've been answering both on the front line for nine years, and last year a single dish coupon brought back 134,000 people. Now I want to build those answers into the product, so stores stop sending coupons by hand and every member gets their own reason to come back.
